query:
SELECT 
  r.id as residentId,
  r.firstName,
  r.lastName,
  r.email,
  p.id as packageId,
  p.packageType,
  p.totalHours,
  p.usedHours,
  p.startDate,
  p.endDate,
  p.isActive,
  p.reminderSent,
  p.expirationEmailSent
FROM residents r
LEFT JOIN packages p ON r.id = p.residentId
WHERE r.lastName = 'Klein' AND r.firstName = 'Nicolas'
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 3;
